purpose: Read an unspoken message from someone’s gesture or behavior.
keywords: Quoted / implied clause + とばかりに
He tapped his chest as if to say, “Leave it to me.”
The dog scratched the door as if to say, “Let’s go already.”
She closed the book as if to say that was the end.
formation: Quoted / implied clause + とばかりに
restrictions: The person need not actually say the implied words.
mistake: It interprets an attitude, rather than reporting a verbatim quotation.
